evidence.observation: Before growth, O2 was 6.6 ppm and pressure 2.968 Torr at Ar 99.7 sccm.
At growth onset, O2 increased to 12.0 ppm and pressure to 3.044 Torr.
O2 and pressure continued rising to 20.7 ppm and 3.122 Torr.
O2 reached 27.2 ppm and pressure 3.209 Torr despite stable Ar at 99.5 sccm and temperature at 749.8 C versus 750 C setpoint; the sustained gas-condition drift suggests a process anomaly.

args.missing_evidence: Normal growth-stage pressure/O2 ranges and a leak-integrity check are needed to distinguish air ingress from growth-related outgassing or exhaust effects; no sample characterization is available.
